members.title: Members
members.rolesHint: Managers invite, remove and change the space. Members may do everything with lists and tasks.
members.inviteText: A link for one person, valid for 7 days. Whoever opens it signs in or creates an account and is then in the space.
members.mailText: nextasks sends the link to this address. It works once, for 7 days.

sidebar.label: Sidebar
sidebar.noLists: No list yet. Add a list

language.title: Language
language.text: nextasks brings English and German. Upload more under Server, Languages; whatever a file lacks shows in English.
language.textMember: nextasks brings English and German; the operator can add more languages.
language.templateHint: The English texts as a file to translate. Upload it under Server, Languages with a code such as es or pt-BR.

server.proxyUnknown: Requests come through a proxy, but NEXTASKS_TRUSTED_PROXIES is not set. nextasks then sees everybody as one sender: whoever guesses wrong often slows down everyone signing in from a browser not used here before. Put the proxy's address into NEXTASKS_TRUSTED_PROXIES. If no proxy stands in front of nextasks, you can ignore this.
server.backupsHint: Tasks, files and the database in one archive. Restoring shows a dry run first.
server.uploadedHint: Uploaded. It is in the list now: check it first, then restore.
server.languagesHint: German and English are built in. Add more as a JSON file; missing texts fall back to English.
server.logHint: Four levels. The two deep ones switch themselves off after an hour. Never task contents, passwords or keys.
server.stripLocation: Remove location and device from photos
server.stripLocationHint: Phones write into every photo where it was taken and with what. On by default.
server.mailHint: For invitations, for confirming mail addresses, and for the reports and notifications each person chooses under My account. Without a server, the link to copy is enough.
server.secretKept: Kept; type only to change it.
server.twoFactorRequiredHint: Every account that signs in with a password must set one up before it gets further. Accounts from the provider bring its own. An account with a password is not affected either when it comes in through a provider for which “{{trusts}}” is on.
server.passwordGiven: The new password, to pass on once:

role.title: Change the role of {{name}}?
role.text: Operators change every setting of this server.

delete.title: Delete {{name}}?
delete.text: The account is deleted and cannot be brought back. Its tasks stay in their spaces.

password.title: New password for {{name}}?
password.text: A random one is made; every sign-in of the account ends.

reset.title: Remove the second factor of {{name}}?
reset.text: For a lost phone: the account signs in with its password only, until it sets up a new one.

signout.title: Sign {{name}} out everywhere?
signout.text: Every browser of the account has to sign in again.

backup_restore.title: Restore this backup?
backup_restore.text: The present state is kept as a backup first. nextasks restarts, everybody signs in again.

backup_download.title: Download this backup?
backup_download.text: It contains every task, file and account. It is not encrypted.

backup_upload.title: Upload a backup?
backup_upload.text: The file joins the list of backups. Nothing is restored until you confirm it there.

unblock.title: Unblock {{name}}?
unblock.text: {{name}} can sign in again afterwards, with their own password or through the sign-in provider.

promote.text: {{name}} can then change every setting of this server.

demote.text: {{name}} becomes a member and can no longer reach the server settings.

block.title: Block {{name}}?
block.text: {{name}} gets in nowhere afterwards: no sign-in, no API token. The tasks stay assigned and can be assigned to others. You can unblock at any time.

server.checkOk: Complete: {{tasks}}, {{files}}. A restore would add {{add}} and remove {{remove}}.
server.checkBad: Damaged: this backup cannot be restored.
server.restarting: nextasks restarts with the backup. The page reloads in a moment.
server.languageAdded: Language added. It shows in the account menu after reloading.
server.logClearText: Every line goes. New ones come as before.
server.filesHint: Files on tasks: how large they may be and what is removed when uploading.
server.inviteText: A link for a new account, without a space yet: the person creates their own or is invited later. Into a space, its manager invites under Members.
server.ownSecondFactorFirst: Set up your own second factor first (My account, Security), or you would be the first one who cannot go on. Not affected is whoever signs in through a provider for which “{{trusts}}” is on.

apiTokens.title: API tokens
apiTokens.text: Accounts connect nextasks with programs this way: nexmail turns mails into tasks, nexdeck shows a card with the tasks due, and Home Assistant, n8n or scripts of your own. A token never does more than its account, and only in its spaces. Off by default.
apiTokens.allowHint: Every account creates its own tokens under My account, Connections.
apiTokens.blockText: The token then answers like none, for good. The account sees it as “blocked by the operator” and may create a new one while API tokens are on.
apiTokens.offHint: Switch API tokens off and every token answers 401. The tokens stay and work again when you switch them on. Tokens of blocked or deleted accounts never count.

server.unlinkText: {{name}} no longer signs in through {{provider}} until the account links itself again. The account is told.

app.title: iPhone app and invitations
app.text: What devices and managers of spaces may do.
app.enabledHint: Off: connected devices get no answers any more, but stay connected.
app.pairingHint: Off: no further iPhones can be connected.
app.invitesHint: Off: managers can no longer create invitation links.
app.noAddress: Without a public address (Sign-in) the app uses the address this browser opens nextasks at.

errors.locale_unusable: This language file cannot be used.
errors.client_required: The request did not say which tab sent it. Reload the page.

errors.public_url_invalid: This address cannot be used. Check how it is written.
errors.public_url_needed: nextasks could not keep the address. Try again, or set it under Sign-in.
errors.mail_off: No mail server is set up.
errors.mail_failed: The mail server did not accept the mail.
errors.push_failed: The push service did not accept the notification.
errors.channel_unavailable: The operator has not set this up.
errors.email_link_invalid: This link no longer works. Enter the address again to get a new one.
errors.email_taken: Another account has confirmed this address already.
errors.email_nothing_waits: No address is waiting to be confirmed.
errors.cannot_delete_self: You cannot delete your own account.
errors.cannot_demote_self: You cannot take the operator role from yourself.
errors.oidc_account: This account signs in through the provider.
errors.backup_invalid: This is not a nextasks backup.
errors.backup_damaged: The backup is damaged. Nothing was changed.
errors.busy: nextasks is busy. Try again in a moment.
errors.totp_enabled: The second factor is on already.
errors.totp_not_enabled: The second factor is not on.
errors.totp_enrolment_expired: The setup took too long. Start again.
errors.totp_code_wrong: The code is not right. Check the time on your phone and try the next one.
errors.second_factor_expired: Too many wrong codes, or too long a wait. Start again with your password.
errors.second_factor_unavailable: The second factor cannot be checked on this installation. Ask the operator to reset it.
errors.second_factor_setup_required: Set up your second factor first.
errors.own_second_factor_first: Set up your own second factor first, on your account page.
errors.use_disable: Turn your own second factor off on your account page.
errors.provider_first: Set up a sign-in provider first, or nobody but you could sign in.
errors.api_off: The operator has not switched API tokens on.
errors.too_many_tokens: An account has at most 20 tokens.
errors.operator_network: The operator's settings are open only from the home network.
errors.display_name_taken: Another account goes by this name.
errors.display_name_invalid: A display name cannot contain control or invisible characters.
errors.public_url_missing: Mail needs the public address of nextasks; the operator sets it under Settings.
errors.too_large: The file is larger than allowed ({{max_mb}} MB).
errors.too_many_pixels: This picture has more pixels than nextasks accepts ({{max_million}} million at most).
errors.password_unchanged: The new password is the same as the current one. Choose another.
errors.upload_aborted: The upload stopped before the end.
errors.invalid_title: The title is empty or too long.
errors.forbidden: You may not do that here.
errors.setup_code_wrong: The setup code is wrong. It stands in the server log.
errors.assignee_no_access: This person cannot work in this space.
errors.last_list: A space keeps at least one list.
errors.not_for_you: This part is not meant for you.
errors.to_self: You do not hand anything to yourself.
errors.invalid_reason: nextasks does not know this reason.
errors.invalid_range: The last day lies before the first.
errors.invalid_time: Only an appointment on one day has hours.
errors.too_many: Too many requests. Please wait a moment.
errors.invalid_text: A checklist item has 1 to 300 characters.
errors.unknown_account: Not every one of these accounts exists.
errors.not_connecting: Start with the address and the code.
errors.emergency_code_wrong: This emergency code is not valid.
errors.account_blocked: This account is blocked. Ask the operator to unblock it.
errors.connecting_already: A connection is under way already: resume it or cancel it.
errors.invalid_account_name: A sign-in name has 2 to 64 characters: letters, digits, dots, dashes or underscores, no spaces.
errors.backups_emergency_only: While connected, only the emergency account downloads and deletes backups.
errors.comment_too_long: A comment has at most 5000 characters.
errors.invite_expired: This invitation has expired. Ask for a new one.
errors.choose_spaces: Choose the spaces the token may see, or all of them on purpose.
errors.token_reads_only: This token only reads. Create one that writes for changes.
errors.bad_preference: This value is not one nextasks offers.
errors.display_name_too_long: The display name is too long, at most {{maximum}} characters.
errors.log_level_from_environment: The log level is fixed by NEXTASKS_LOG_LEVEL.
errors.invalid_status: This is not a status nextasks knows.
errors.invalid_priority: This is not a priority nextasks knows.
errors.origin_refused: The API is for programs, not for web pages.
errors.slow_down: Too many requests with this token. Wait a minute.
errors.invite_unknown: This invitation is not valid (expired, used or withdrawn).
errors.private_space: The space “Private” is yours alone; nobody can be invited there.
errors.app_pairing_disabled: The operator turned off connecting new devices.
errors.app_address_missing: The server does not know its public address. The operator enters it under Settings, Server, Sign-in.
errors.app_too_many_pairings: Five codes are waiting already. Cancel one or wait ten minutes.
errors.not_signed_in: You are not signed in (any more).
errors.bad_client: The request did not come from the nextasks page. Reload the page.
errors.app_disabled: The operator turned the iPhone app off.
errors.app_pairing_unknown: The server does not know this code, or it has expired.
errors.cursor_expired: The state was too old; nextasks loads everything again.
errors.unknown_timezone: The server does not know this time zone.
errors.due_changed: The due date changed in the meantime.
errors.parent_missing: Its list or space is missing on the server.
errors.invalid: The server did not accept the change.

setup.title: Set up nextasks
setup.text: The first account runs this server: it may invite others and change every setting.
setup.codeHint: It stands in the server log (docker logs nextasks), or set NEXTASKS_SETUP_TOKEN.

login.title: Sign in
login.ended: Your session was ended, for example because your account was blocked or signed out everywhere. Sign in again.

code.title: Second factor
code.text: The code from your authenticator app, or a recovery code.
code.label: Code
code.hint: Six digits, or a recovery code from paper.

invite.title: Invitation
invite.intoSpace: You are invited into the space “{{space}}” ({{role}}).
invite.invalidText: This invitation is not valid any more: it was used, expired or was withdrawn. Ask for a new one.
invite.noWay: Sign-in with a password is off and no sign-in provider is set up. Ask the operator.
invite.haveAccount: This link is for a new account. You are signed in as {{name}} already and do not need it.
invite.name: Sign-in name
invite.nameHint: 2 to 64 characters: letters without accents, digits, dot, hyphen or underscore, no spaces. You change the name others see afterwards under My account.
invite.expiredText: This invitation has expired. Ask for a new one.

space.name: Name
space.newHint: You manage the new space and invite others by link. Everyone in a space sees all its lists.
space.deleteSure: Move the space and all its lists to the trash
space.prefsText: Hidden spaces are left out of the sidebar, the collections and the search. Notifications and reminders keep coming. The setting is yours only, on all your devices.

about.subtitle: Tasks for families and small groups, on your own server.

updates.title: Updates
updates.text: Whether a newer version of nextasks is out.
updates.dailyHint: Asks GitHub for the newest release. Off: only when you press the button.
updates.whatGoesOut: Only the question goes out: a request to api.github.com for the newest release of nextasks, with no names, tasks or settings. It is the only call nextasks makes on its own.

me.title: My account

profile.displayHint: How others see you. Empty shows your sign-in name {{name}}; you still sign in with it.
profile.name: Sign-in name
profile.hint: A photo from your phone or camera. It is cut to a square, and nothing of the file but the picture is kept: no place, no device.
profile.displayHintPassword: How others see you. Empty shows your sign-in name {{name}}; you still sign in with it.

password.title: Password
password.done: Password changed. Other browsers have to sign in again.
password.mismatch: The two passwords are not the same.

sessions.title: Other browsers
sessions.text: Signs you out everywhere except here, for example after losing a phone.
sessions.done: Every other browser is signed out.

me.setupFirst: The operator requires a second factor. Set it up here, then you can go on.
me.keysWait: Works only once you set up a second factor.

twofactor.title: Second factor
twofactor.lead: Besides the password, a code from an app on your phone (any authenticator app that takes a QR code). Recovery codes on paper get you in when the phone is gone.
twofactor.provider: You sign in through the provider; its second factor applies.
twofactor.scan: Scan this code with the app, or type the key below into it. Then enter the code the app shows, and your password.
twofactor.qr: QR code for the authenticator app
twofactor.passwordHint: Proves it is you at the keyboard.
twofactor.codesLead: Each one signs you in once, when the phone is not at hand. They are shown only now: copy them or save them as a file, and keep them apart from the phone.
twofactor.renewText: The old recovery codes stop working. Enter your password to create new ones.
twofactor.disableText: From then on the password alone signs you in. Enter it to turn the second factor off.
twofactor.lowCodes: Few recovery codes left. Create new ones while you can still sign in.

invite.noMail: Without a mail server nextasks sends nothing: copy the link and pass it on yourself.
invite.once: The link works once. It is shown only now.

trash.title: Trash
trash.hint: Deleted things stay here for 30 days, then they are gone for good.

apiTokens.title: API tokens
apiTokens.text: For programs such as nexmail, nexdeck, Home Assistant or n8n. A token never sees more than your account, and only its spaces. A token never deletes anything for good.
apiTokens.name: Name, so you know it again

levels.readHint: Spaces, lists, tasks and the numbers for a dashboard.
levels.writeHint: Also creates, changes, ticks off, reopens and trashes tasks. Only in spaces where you may write.

apiTokens.allSpaces: Every space I may see, later ones too
apiTokens.chooseOne: Choose at least one space, or all of them above.
apiTokens.shownOnce: Token “{{name}}” made. It is shown only now. Copy it into your program; nextasks keeps only a checksum.
apiTokens.header: As a header in n8n or nexdeck (HTTP Request, Header Auth)
apiTokens.off: The operator has not switched API tokens on. Ask them if you want to connect nextasks with nexmail, nexdeck or n8n.
apiTokens.offOperator: Switch them on under Settings, Server, API.
apiTokens.whatItDoesText: Every request carries the token in the header Authorization: Bearer, the answers are JSON. Reading: spaces, lists, tasks and the numbers for a dashboard. With “Read and write” also creating, changing, ticking off, reopening and trashing tasks; every device sees it at once. Deleting for good, members and rights are never touched through the API.

tiles.label: Collections
tiles.sub_one: one open task in all spaces

sync.failed: The server does not answer as expected.
sync.offline_one: No connection. One change is waiting.
sync.serverOld: This server does not know the new interface yet (/api/app/1). It needs an update.

notice.forbidden: You may not do that here. The server keeps its version.
notice.not_found: This is gone, or you no longer see it.
notice.invalid: The server did not accept the change. Its version stands.
notice.gone: This was deleted for good in the meantime.
notice.already_done: Already completed, probably on another device.
notice.due_changed: The due date changed in the meantime. Completing was dropped.
notice.parent_missing: Its list is missing on the server. The change was dropped.
notice.moved_to_private: Its list is missing on the server. The task is now in “{{list}}”.
notice.dropped_assignees_one: One person is not in the space and was not assigned.
notice.dropped_assignees_other: {{count}} people are not in the space and were not assigned.
notice.space_left: You are no longer in the space “{{name}}”.
notice.space_left_copied_one: You are no longer in that space. Your unsent change is kept as a copy in “{{list}}”.
notice.space_left_copied_other: You are no longer in that space. {{count}} tasks with unsent changes are kept as copies in “{{list}}”.
notice.upload_lost: The file “{{name}}” was lost when the page reloaded. Please attach it again.
notice.too_large: That was too large for the server.
notice.invalid_input: The server could not read the change.

list.name: Name
list.moveHint: The list moves to the other space with all its tasks. Assignments to people who are not members there are dropped.
list.deleteSure: Move the list and all its tasks to the trash
list.cleared_one: One completed task is in the trash.
list.cleared_other: {{count}} completed tasks are in the trash.
list.notifyHint: You get a notification when others add or complete something here.

reminder.paneToggle: Show or hide the details in the side column
reminder.paneToggleFor: Show or hide the details of “{{title}}” in the side column

detail.label: Details of the task
detail.title: Title
detail.urlBad: A link starts with http://, https:// or mailto:.
detail.placeHint: A location is set in the iPhone app.
detail.assigneesHint: One is enough: whoever completes it first completes it for everyone.
detail.emptyFile: An empty file cannot be attached.
detail.notesNeedTitle: Pictures can be added once the task has a title.
detail.notesTooLong: The note is longer than {{max}} characters and is not saved like this.

zone.title: Time zone
zone.text: Times of tasks count in this time zone, notifications too.

device.title: iPhone app
device.text: Connect the nextasks app on your iPhone or iPad with this server.
device.scan: Scan the code in the app under “Connect server”.

push.title: Browser
push.text: Notifications arrive also while nextasks is closed. What arrives is chosen in the table above.
push.denied: The browser blocked notifications for this site. Allow them in the browser settings.
push.iosHint: On iPhone and iPad, notifications in the browser only arrive when nextasks is on the Home Screen as an app (Share › Add to Home Screen).
push.deniedShort: Blocked in this browser, see below.

pwa.title: As an app
pwa.text: Installed, nextasks starts like an app: in its own window without the browser bar, with its own icon, and also offline.
pwa.asked: The browser asked. If you agreed, nextasks is among your apps.
pwa.iosHint: On iPhone and iPad: Share › Add to Home Screen.
pwa.update: A new version of nextasks is here.
pwa.offline: No connection to the server. nextasks keeps trying and loads as soon as the network is back.

notify.title: Notifications
notify.lead: Choose what nextasks sends you, and which way.

mail.title: Mail
mail.text: nextasks only mails an address you confirmed through a link.
mail.pending: A link is on its way to {{address}} and works until {{until}}. Until you open it, the previous address stays in use.
mail.sent: Link sent to {{address}}. Open it to confirm the address.
mail.suggestion: Your sign-in provider knows you as {{address}}.
mail.noPublic: Mail needs the public address of nextasks; the operator enters it under Settings.
mail.removed: Address removed. nextasks no longer sends you mail.

notify.reportsText: A report with nothing in it is not sent.
notify.dailyText: Every day: what is overdue, what is due today, and what was newly assigned to you since the last report.
notify.weeklyText: Once a week: what was done in your spaces, also by others, and what is due in the next seven days.
notify.zone: Times are in your time zone {{zone}}. You can change it in your profile.

events.assigned: A task was assigned to me
events.due: A task with a time is due
events.changed: Others change something in lists I follow
events.joined: Someone joined one of my spaces

notify.changedHint: Choose the lists you follow in the list itself with “{{label}}”.

confirmEmail.title: Confirm mail address
confirmEmail.done: Confirmed. nextasks now sends mail to {{email}}.

unsubscribe.title: Unsubscribe
unsubscribe.done: Unsubscribed. You can turn it on again under My account › Notifications.

join.title: Invitation
join.text: You are invited to the space “{{space}}”.
join.already: You are a member already. To the space
join.unknownText: The invitation has expired, was used or withdrawn. Ask for a new link.

connect.title: Connect iPhone
connect.text: The nextasks app wants to connect with your account.
connect.textNamed: “{{device}}” wants to connect with your account.

menu.hideInPane: Take out of the side column
